archetype_reasoning: Diet, health, and wellness apps require an approachable, calming, and trustworthy vibe. We are avoiding the dark 'bro-fitness' aesthetic in favor of a premium, grounded feel.

spacing_and_layout.general: Mobile-first approach. Use p-6 or p-8 for containers. The app feels premium by letting elements breathe.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Horizontal swipeable card carousels for primary data (macros), and vertical 'story-like' feeds for daily logged meals.
spacing_and_layout.borders_and_radii: Use rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for cards. Nested elements use rounded-xl. Never use fully sharp corners in this earthy theme.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use the 'Clay & Crisp' Neumorphism pattern for widgets. Flat surface with a 1px border (#E5E0D8) and soft ambient shadow.
visual_enhancers.camera_scanner: For the food/menu scanner, implement 'The Tracing Beam' overlay. A glowing border frame with blur-md behind it to guide the user's camera.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only use for the bottom tab bar and sticky headers. Heavy blur (backdrop-blur-xl) with a white/70% tint and 1px top border (#E5E0D8).

components.buttons: Large touch targets (min h-14). Solid primary accent color (#D97352) with text-white, or soft surface_alt with text_primary.
components.inputs: Shadcn-style but adapted for Native. Soft backgrounds (#F3EFE9) instead of outline borders. Focus state adds 1px primary border.
components.cards: Cardless approach where possible, or extremely subtle cards. Use spacing and typography for hierarchy.

image_urls.description: Vibrant organic salad, premium lifestyle. Use as header/background for onboarding flow to inspire healthy eating.
Fresh salad in a bowl on a wooden table. Use as placeholder for AI-scanned meals or diet plan headers.
Buffet/cafeteria food. Use for the 'Scan Workplace Menu' feature card.
Fitness focus. Use as thumbnail for daily exercise suggestions.

motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Smooth slide-ins for onboarding. Spring physics for dashboard cards.
motion_and_interactions.feedback: Haptic feedback on every logged meal or successful menu scan.
motion_and_interactions.gamification: Confetti or particle effects when a user hits daily macro goals or unlocks a motivational surprise.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' fonts using expo-font. Do not use Inter or default system sans.
Ensure the UI uses NativeWind (Tailwind for React Native) keeping the classes defined in 'scales'.
Build an intuitive bottom tab navigator: Dashboard, Diet Plan, Camera (Scanner), Exercise, Profile.
The Onboarding flow must be a gamified quiz (3-4 screens) asking for height, weight, age, activity level, and goals, before landing on the dashboard.
Implement the Camera Scanner view with a 'Tracing Beam' UI overlay. Add a toggle for 'Scan Plate' vs 'Scan Menu'.
Dashboard should feature swipeable macro cards and a vertical feed for daily meals.
